lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.structures: Six NPC nodal CTVs: bilateral II+III+Va, IV+Vb and Ib
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.license: Source: GPL-3.0; weights: distributed by the authors without a separate licence; dataset: CC BY 4.0
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.limitations: NPC-specific institutional contouring conventions. Training data include contrast-enhanced and non-contrast CT. Grouped labels cannot be split into individual nodal levels. The paper also calls the lower-neck group IV+Vb+Vc; ROI names follow the release table. Development-cohort fixture checks do not establish independent accuracy. The released checkpoint has seven foreground IDs, but the published label table defines six. ID 7 and correspondence with the published groups are unresolved; RTSTRUCT export is blocked.
lnctvseg_nnunet_v1.description: LNCTVSeg nnU-Net v1: NPC-specific grouped elective nodal CTVs, not individual levels or visible-node masks.
